name:        useClickableContainer
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: Makes a container element clickable while preserving nested interactive element behavior. Solves the "nested interactive elements" problem: when a card is clickable but contains buttons/links, clicking those should NOT trigger the card's action. Detects interactive ancestors between the click target and the container, and ignores text selections. Supports href navigation (including middle-click and Ctrl/Cmd+click for new tabs).
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useClickableContainer

name:        useInteractiveRole
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: Resolves what a polymorphic component should render as, in one place: href wins, then onClick, then an interactive trigger context supplied by a parent (Popover, DropdownMenu and friends), then inert. Use it in any component that is sometimes a link, sometimes a button, and sometimes plain content; Token, Thumbnail, Item and ClickableCard all do. Because context is part of the resolution, a component built on it becomes a valid trigger for new surfaces without changing.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useInteractiveRole

name:        useLinkComponent
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Link
description: Resolves which component renders a link, so a custom component's links follow the app's router the same way Astryx's own links do. The order is the as argument, then the nearest LinkProvider's component, then a native anchor. Render the returned component with href (and to, for a router that reads it). Before rendering it checks both destinations under the Link href rule: a rejected destination renders an anchor with no destination, and a custom router is never invoked with it. A custom component receives to={href} unless to is passed explicitly.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useLinkComponent

name:        useLinkify
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core
description: Finds URLs, email addresses and custom patterns in plain text and returns React nodes with a Link for each match; the links respect LinkProvider for client-side routing. Use it wherever user- or tool-authored plain text should grow safe, styled links without pre-parsing it into markup: activity feeds, comment threads, description fields. Custom patterns turn project-specific references (issue numbers like #123, ticket IDs) into links by supplying a regex plus an href builder - e.g. an issue tracker pattern that maps captures onto its URL scheme. When matches overlap, the earliest one wins, and at the same start a custom pattern wins over the built-in ones, so a custom #123 pattern coexists with URL detection in the same string.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useLinkify
